name: Aster & Tide
label: Aster & Tide × Tasteprint
description: A fictional premium-travel campaign used to demonstrate the reusable Tasteprint campaign engine.

copy.title: Find the escape you’d actually book.
copy.lede: Make a few instinctive tradeoffs. Aster & Tide uses Tasteprint to match the way you travel with a small collection of escapes built around how you want the trip to feel.
copy.catalogTitle: Aster & Tide picks for this Tasteprint
copy.catalogSubtitle: A fictional client catalog demonstrating how a partner can map Tasteprint results into products, packages, destinations, or offers.

0.subtitle: Forget the brochure. Pick the view your nervous system wants.

4.title: Aster & Tide can make one part of the trip exceptional. Which one gets the budget?

catalog.name: Amalfi Afterglow
catalog.description: Slow mornings, a design-led cliffside stay, long dinners and one private day on the water.

catalog.name: Lisbon, Loosely
catalog.description: A beautiful home base, two anchor reservations, and deliberately empty space for wandering into the rest.

catalog.name: Madeira in Motion
catalog.description: Big scenery, guided movement when it matters and enough recovery time that the trip never becomes a punishment.

catalog.name: Tokyo, Composed
catalog.description: High novelty with the important logistics handled: neighborhood food, design, nightlife and one reset afternoon.

catalog.name: Barcelona After Nine
catalog.description: Late dinners, social momentum, beach recovery and enough unscripted time for the trip to develop a plot.

catalog.name: Palm Springs: Out of Office
catalog.description: Architecture, pool time, excellent food and almost no pressure to turn relaxation into an accomplishment.
